title: pad
body:
## pad

Add a straight extrusion from a Body-owned closed profile: stock for the first feature, then bosses or ribs for later features. Omit base only for the first additive feature; subsequent Pads name the current tip. Length is total distance in mm, including symmetric mode. A planar-face-attached profile moves with its support when native dimensions change; an explicit frame remains independent. Each result must be one connected valid solid.

Native binding: `PartDesign::Pad`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | yes | `body` |
| `profile` | one node | yes | `profile` |
| `base` | one node | no | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | Positive first-Pad thickness in mm along +Z, default 10 mm. Omit when drive.length supplies a persistent native relationship. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `10` |
| `direction` | Forward (default) follows the profile normal; backward opposes it; symmetric spans both sides. A top-face Pocket normally cuts backward. Finite symmetric length is the total span. | `{"type":"enum","values":["forward","backward","symmetric"]}` | omitted |
